name: Treder Website Fix Finder
author: Ben Treder

sections.description:
Website Fix Finder runs a comprehensive audit of your WordPress site and produces a scored report in plain English — no technical jargon, no confusing dashboards. It shows you exactly what is wrong, why it matters, and how to fix it, in terms a business owner can act on immediately.

All checks run entirely on your server. No data is sent anywhere.

What It Checks

Website Fix Finder runs over 40 checks across 8 categories:

Website Basics
Site title, tagline, homepage type, HTTPS/SSL, clean permalink structure, search engine visibility, timezone, and language.

SEO Foundations
Homepage title quality, readable homepage content, H1 heading presence and count, number of published pages, descriptive page titles, image alt text, internal links, and SEO plugin/sitemap detection.

Trust Signals
Privacy policy page, contact page, about page, terms or disclaimer page, visible contact info on the homepage, and trust-building language.

Local Business Readiness
Local intent keywords, address or location information, Google Business Profile link, and LocalBusiness schema markup.

Mobile & User Clarity
Clear call to action, navigation menu, non-empty homepage, service or product pages, and shortcode clutter detection.

Content Quality
Placeholder text detection, default WordPress pages, homepage content depth, page variety (About / Services / Contact), and stale default posts.

Technical Health
PHP version, WordPress version, active theme, debug display visibility, Site URL / Home URL consistency, uploads directory writability, REST API accessibility, and WP Cron status.

Conversion Readiness
CTA phrases, contact path clarity, service/offer language, social proof, value proposition, and site-wide contact info.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Fix Finder in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  3. Click Run Website Scan.
  4. Review your Website Fix Score, top priority fixes, and full category-by-category breakdown.

Privacy

Website Fix Finder runs entirely on your server. No data is sent to any external service. Scan results are stored only in your WordPress database (wp_options) and are removed automatically when you uninstall the plugin.

Who Is This For?

  • Small business owners who built their own website and want an honest assessment
  • Freelancers and agencies who need a fast first-pass audit for client sites
  • Anyone who wants to improve their site’s trust, SEO, and conversions without hiring a consultant

Upgrade to Premium

Treder Website Fix Finder is useful on its own. Premium upgrade options may be offered separately from BenTreder.com for deeper scans, branded reports, scan history, client-friendly exports, and agency workflows.

Premium is optional. The free plugin works without a Premium purchase, account, or external service.

Premium features may include:

  • Multi-page scans
  • Branded PDF reports
  • Scan history and before/after tracking
  • Client report mode
  • WooCommerce checks
  • Local SEO expansion checks
  • Exportable issue lists

Learn more at BenTreder.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the treder-website-fix-finder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Fix Finder in the admin sidebar and click Run Website Scan.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send my data anywhere?

No. All checks run entirely within your WordPress install. Nothing is sent to any external server.

How long does a scan take?

A typical scan completes in 3–10 seconds depending on your server speed and the number of pages on your site.

Will running a scan affect my site’s performance or visitors?

Scans run in the WordPress admin only and are triggered manually. They do not affect front-end performance or the visitor experience.

Does this plugin guarantee my site will rank better in Google?

No plugin can guarantee search rankings. Website Fix Finder helps you identify and fix common issues that negatively affect SEO, trust, and user experience — which can improve your results over time.

What does the score mean?

Your Website Fix Score reflects how many of the 40+ checks your site passes:

  • 90–100 — Excellent: Your site is well configured.
  • 75–89 — Strong: A few areas to tighten up.
  • 60–74 — Needs Improvement: Several issues worth addressing.
  • 40–59 — Needs Work: Multiple problems likely affecting your results.
  • 0–39 — Critical Attention Needed: Significant issues that should be fixed soon.

Can I re-run the scan after making fixes?

Yes. Click Run Website Scan at any time to get an updated score and see your progress.

Is there a Premium version?

Premium upgrade options are available separately from BenTreder.com. Planned features include multi-page deep scans, branded PDF reports, weekly scheduled scans with email summaries, score history tracking, WooCommerce and local SEO checks, and an agency white-label mode. Premium is optional and the free plugin works on its own.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

Uninstalling the plugin removes all stored scan data from the database automatically. Nothing is left behind.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • 40+ checks across 8 categories: Website Basics, SEO Foundations, Trust Signals, Local Business Readiness, Mobile & User Clarity, Content Quality, Technical Health, and Conversion Readiness.
  • Scored report with grade, top priorities, quick wins, and per-category breakdowns.
  • Filter bar (All / Failed / Warnings / Passed) and expandable check detail panels.
  • Copy Report Summary button for easy sharing.
  • No external data transmission — all processing is server-local.
